cards.title: ChatGPT Mobile App Gets Agentic Features
cards.body: Pro and Plus users can now use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks. This brings advanced AI capabilities directly to mobile devices for enhanced productivity.

cards.title: Americans Worry About AI Despite Daily Use
cards.body: Greater exposure to AI does not reduce public unease about the technology. Support for AI regulation remains strong even among frequent users.

cards.title: YouTube Music Launches Conversational AI Search
cards.body: Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language. The feature is built directly into the YouTube Music app for seamless discovery.

cards.title: YouTube Enables Custom AI-Powered Feed Creation
cards.body: Users can describe the videos they want to see and Gemini builds a personalized feed around the request. This gives viewers greater control over their algorithm.

cards.title: YouTube Studio Gets New AI Creator Tools
cards.body: YouTube is adding AI features to generate ideas and monitor thumbnail performance. These tools help creators optimize their content strategy.

cards.title: Spotify Rolls Out AI Taste Profile Feature
cards.body: Taste Profile is now available to Premium users in the U.S., showing how Spotify understands their music preferences. Users can reshape recommendations using natural language.

cards.title: Ema Raises $77M for Enterprise AI Software
cards.body: The startup has now raised $140 million total and serves over 50 enterprise customers including Google and Microsoft. Ema is capturing market share as AI disrupts enterprise software.

cards.title: Greece's PM Says No Government Ready for AI
cards.body: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis admitted that governments are unprepared for AI's imminent impact. He emphasized the need for proactive policy preparation.

cards.title: Snorkel AI Triples Valuation to $3.5 Billion
cards.body: The startup raised $350 million in Series E funding as demand for AI training data surges. Snorkel's data-as-a-service approach continues to attract major investment.

cards.title: Qualcomm Launches AI-Focused Smartphone Chips
cards.body: The new flagship chip can run a 30B mixture-of-expert model locally on smartphones. Qualcomm is prioritizing on-device AI capabilities for mobile devices.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Inspired by OpenClaw Design
cards.body: Meta acknowledged that its Muse AI assistant was 'heavily inspired' by OpenClaw, including workspace filenames and content similarities. Meta claims Muse was built from scratch despite the resemblance.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models
cards.body: The new models promise lower costs and fewer mistakes than predecessors. They share the same architecture as Astra, OpenAI's multimodal system.

cards.title: Anthropic Releases Opus 5.5 with Lower Costs
cards.body: Opus 5.5 delivers Fable-level performance at reduced pricing. Anthropic calls it 'the strongest-performing model we've tested to date.'

cards.title: AstroForge Deploys AI in Next Spacecraft
cards.body: Autonomy-1 will carry a small transformer-based AI model commanding the space probe. The mission demonstrates AI's potential in autonomous space operations.

cards.title: Hello Robot Demos Stretch 4 at TechCrunch
cards.body: CEO Aaron Edsinger will bring Hello Robot's Stretch 4 for a live demonstration on the Real World AI Stage. The event showcases practical AI robotics applications.

cards.title: Don't Be Fooled by AI Hype This Summer
cards.body: Timnit Gebru and Emily M. Bender warn that recent AI breakthroughs may be overstated. Claims like Anthropic's Claude finding vulnerabilities better than security experts deserve scrutiny.

cards.title: AI-Enabled Border Towers Fail to Prevent Deaths
cards.body: MIT Technology Review's investigation found people walked undetected through areas surveilled by advanced, AI-enabled surveillance towers. Despite billions spent, the virtual wall hasn't prevented tragic border crossings.

cards.title: New Anthropic, OpenAI Models Promise More for Less
cards.body: Both AI giants released new models claiming improved performance at lower costs. The developments signal intensifying competition in the AI model market.

cards.title: Microsoft Disrupts AI Platform Compromising 12,000 Accounts
cards.body: Microsoft took action against an AI-assisted platform that had compromised thousands of user accounts. The incident highlights security vulnerabilities in AI systems.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Assistant Faces Serious Security Flaw
cards.body: Meta's AI assistant Muse was discovered to have a critical zero-day vulnerability. The security issue raises concerns about enterprise AI tool safety.
